title: kith-store V19 migration resets chats created after V18 to sentinel -1
description: SCHEMA_V19 resets ALL chats with changed_at_counter > 0 to created_at_counter = -1. The comment acknowledges this: chats created after V18 that never received a message are also reset. Such chats will appear in Chat/changes updated[] instead of created[] on the next sync. For an existing user upgrading through V18→V19, any chat created between V18 and V19 migrations will be misclassified as updated rather than created for a client that was at sinceState before that chat was created. This is a one-time migration artifact that resolves itself after the next full Chat/get. Not data-loss, but could cause clients to display a chat in updated without ever having added it to created[], which violates RFC 8620 §5.2 if clients rely on seeing created[] to initialize their local cache.
